Alias of the day-ahead energy-price proxy used by the primary residual models.
carrier_q05, carrier_q10, carrier_q50, carrier_q90 and carrier_q95 from the fold-specific Chronos-2 forecasts.
carrier_width90 is q95 minus q05; carrier_lower_spread is q50 minus q10; carrier_upper_spread is q90 minus q50; carrier_energy_difference is q50 minus energy_proxy.
dow_sin and dow_cos encode the weekday; is_weekend identifies Saturday and Sunday; annual_sin and annual_cos use the day of year with a 365.25-day period.
Forecast load minus external schedule, fixed output, photovoltaic generation and wind generation.
Lagged real-time LMP minus lagged day-ahead LMP at the same timestamp offset.
For each curve u defined in the notes, u_day_{mean,std,min,max,deviation,rank} gives its daily mean, sample standard deviation, minimum, maximum, deviation from the mean and percentile rank.
u_known_slot_{-4,-2,-1,1,2,4} shifts each released daily curve by the indicated half-hour intervals; missing boundary values use the nearest available value within that curve.
congestion_day_{mean,std,min,max,deviation} describes the released day-ahead congestion trajectory using the daily statistics and point deviation.
